text:
zoe: FYI I hit a weird failure in the Next eval harness sample when onboarding — Playwright test that validates embeddings intermittently sees 401s and then retries cause duplicate eval runs. Anyone seen this? :confused:
ricky: Hmm, which sample and branch?
zoe: next-evals-starter, branch: eval-onboard. Steps: npm i, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run tests: npm run test:e2e. CI shows flakes where the harness posts embeddings twice and the eval job runs twice.
omar: Can you paste failing CI log snippet?
zoe: copy: 

```
[playwright] POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 401
[playwright] auth: refreshing token start
[playwright] POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 200 (retry)
[playwright] eval-harness: job queued id=J12
[playwright] POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 200 (duplicate)
```

zoe: You can see a 401 then refresh then a second embeddings call after the eval job queued which looks like the harness re-run.
mira: The harness kicks off server-side then Playwright also triggers a client-side check as part of the test flow. Hybrid SSR + client test can cause duplicate runs.
ricky: Is the issue auth-only or also dedupe? If the SDK refresh logic retries and the harness code separately retries on network errors, you can end up with two eval jobs.
omar: Repro locally: when my machine's clock drift caused the SDK token expiry check to think token was stale, it tried to refresh while another request raced in. JS SDK doesn't block concurrent refreshes by default. Python SDK had a single-refresh mutex.
zoe: Short-term fix I pushed to the sample: update the test harness to stub the embeddings endpoint and assert single POST, and add test retry tolerance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-evals-starter/pull/34
ci-bot: Linked PR to CI run #5678 — flaky tests suppressed for now.
mira: Also added a README note: "Local clock skew and hybrid SSR tests can cause token refresh races — run `ntpdate` or use mocked endpoints for determinism."
sdk-team: Filed SDK issue with repro and logs: SDK-741 - JS SDK: single-inflight auth refresh + optional coalescing for embeddings (https://tracker.redwood.ai/SDK-741). We'll prioritize in next sprint.
zoe: Another onboarding friction: the sample requires setting NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY in two places (app and test env) and docs weren't clear — I clarified README to list env vars and provided a .env.template.
ricky: Nice. Also consider adding a small dev script that seeds a short-lived token so folks don't have to create a full API key for demos.
omar: For the SDK fix, plan: 1) implement refresh mutex per client instance; 2) add optional docs/config for request coalescing; 3) unit tests to assert only one refresh regardless of concurrent failing requests.
sdk-team: I'll add the unit tests and a simple e2e that simulates 401 then concurrent requests.
zoe: Thanks — with the sample patch + README tweak CI flakes are down. I'll revert the test stubbing once SDK fix lands. Closing loop, will post a follow-up when SDK PR merges. :thumbsup:
